input.instruction: Complete a liability-review handoff. Disposition reflects the required staff liability decision; unknown optional evidence does not block the handoff. Fill exactly the specified document fields from the supplied conversation and records. Normalize dates to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Copy names, addresses, emails, and identifiers with the spelling supplied. This is an extraction-only task; actions must be empty. In the response distinguish drafting from execution.

messages.text: My downstairs neighbor says my plant pot fell and cut his arm on October 6, 2026. He wants me to promise the insurer will pay.
Did you see the fall, and has anyone determined whose pot it was?
I was at work. He sent a picture of a broken pot by 18 Harbor Steps, Morrow, US. Several neighbors keep pots there. I do not accept that it was mine.
What would you like passed to the liability team?
Record his injury allegation and my uncertainty about ownership. Contact me at imani.reed@post.example; do not contact him directly yet.
Do you have an agreed medical amount or a finding of fault?
No agreed amount and no finding. He says the clinic bill may be around $600, but I have not seen it. Please ask a staff member to review.

injury_alleged.description: Whether a third-party injury is alleged, without treating it as verified.

ownership_status.description: disputed means a party contests ownership; confirmed means explicit agreement; unknown means nobody establishes ownership.

estimated_medical_amount.description: Reported numeric estimate in USD, null if none; never a verified bill.

medical_amount_verified.description: True only for a supplied verified bill; false if explicitly unverified.

contact_email.description: Customer contact approved for staff follow-up.

direct_neighbor_contact_authorized.description: Whether the customer explicitly authorizes direct contact with the neighbor.
